newsitem.title: FRANCE: France mulls euro keyring calculator.
newsitem.headline: France mulls euro keyring calculator.

text.p: France is considering producing a popular keyring calculator converting francs to euros to avoid headaches when the single European currency comes into effect in 1999, government spokesman Alain Lamassoure said on Wednesday.

Lamassoure said President Jacques Chirac suggested in a cabinet meeting that experts should look into making a small calculator -- perhaps a keyring -- that would allow people to easily convert francs into euros and back by pushing two or three buttons.
He said the calculator should be "user-friendly, strong, easy to read for the short-sighted and widely available to the population".
